title: Unlock Complex Office Work with Millions of Context! Kingsoft Office Linti Fully Launched, DeepSeek-V4 Official Version Dual Models
excerpt: Kingsoft Office’s AI office intelligence agent "Lingxi Professional Edition" announced on August 14, 2026, that it has officially integrated the latest flagship
content_html:
Kingsoft Office’s AI office intelligence agent "Lingxi Professional Edition" announced on August 14, 2026, that it has officially integrated the latest flagship model of DeepSeek, DeepSeek-V4-Pro General Version (V4-Pro-0813). Users can directly experience it without any additional configuration by manually switching within the product.

As DeepSeek's latest flagship product, V4-Pro-0813 supports an ultra-long context of up to 1 million tokens natively, with a maximum output of 384,000 tokens per session. Its performance in various benchmark tests has been significantly improved compared to the Preview version.

In terms of practical scenarios, Lingxi Professional Edition differs from traditional AI products that only use conversation as the end goal. It can continuously understand users' historical documents, meeting materials, and personal preferences, and autonomously call upon various tools such as documents, spreadsheets, browsers, code, and data processing to advance complex tasks, ultimately delivering native Office results that are editable, traceable, and collaborative.

With the integration of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the intelligent agent (Agent) execution workflow of Lingxi Professional Edition in requirements breakdown, tool invocation, and result delivery has become more complete, significantly enhancing the stability of automated processing in complex office scenarios. Currently, the DeepSeek-V4 General Version series is fully available in Lingxi Professional Edition, including the Flash and Pro versions, and is now open for all users to use.

content_html_zh:
金山办公AI办公智能代理“灵犀专业版”于2026年8月14日宣布，正式集成DeepSeek最新旗舰机型DeepSeek-V4-Pro通用版（V4-Pro-0813）。 用户无需任何额外配置，只需在产品内手动切换即可直接体验。

作为DeepSeek的最新旗舰产品，V4-Pro-0813原生支持高达100万个token的超长上下文，每个会话最大输出384,000个token。 其在各项基准测试中的性能相比预览版都有了显着的提升。

在实际场景上，灵犀专业版不同于传统的仅以对话为最终目标的AI产品。 它可以持续了解用户的历史文档、会议材料和个人喜好，并自主调用文档、电子表格、浏览器、代码和数据处理等各种工具来推进复杂的任务，最终交付可编辑、可追踪和协作的原生 Office 结果。

通过DeepSeek-V4-Pro的集成，灵犀专业版在需求分解、工具调用、结果交付等方面的智能代理（Agent）执行工作流程变得更加完善，显着增强了复杂办公场景下自动化处理的稳定性。 目前，DeepSeek-V4通用版系列已全面提供灵犀专业版，包括Flash版和Pro版，现已开放给所有用户使用。
